short_title: VLAN 10 PC cannot reach another VLAN
symptom: PC has IP 192.168.10.20 but cannot reach 192.168.20.10
topology_note: Switching/trunk configuration in the lab topology
show_outputs: Switch shows VLAN 10 exists but trunk output does not list VLAN 10 as allowed
expected_fault: VLAN 10 is missing from the trunk allowed list
fix_steps: Add VLAN 10 to the trunk allowed list; verify trunk; retest ping

short_title: Access port placed in wrong VLAN
symptom: PC receives an address from the wrong subnet
topology_note: Switching/trunk configuration in the lab topology
show_outputs: show vlan brief shows Gi0/3 in VLAN 20; endpoint should be VLAN 10
expected_fault: Access port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10
fix_steps: Assign Gi0/3 to VLAN 10; verify access mode; renew DHCP

symptom: Host in VLAN 30 has no local connectivity
topology_note: Switching/trunk configuration in the lab topology
show_outputs: show vlan brief does not contain VLAN 30
expected_fault: VLAN 30 has not been created on the switch
fix_steps: Create VLAN 30; assign the correct access ports; verify

topology_note: Switching/trunk configuration in the lab topology
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk reports native VLAN 99 on one side and VLAN 1 on the other
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch between trunk endpoints
fix_steps: Configure matching native VLANs on both trunk endpoints; verify

topology_note: Switching/trunk configuration in the lab topology
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk lacks voice VLAN 20 on uplink
expected_fault: Voice VLAN is not permitted across the trunk
fix_steps: Permit the voice VLAN on the uplink; verify phone registration

symptom: PC can reach local subnet but not remote server
topology_note: Endpoint and SVI/default-gateway configuration
show_outputs: ipconfig shows gateway 192.168.10.254 while SVI is 192.168.10.1
expected_fault: Endpoint has an incorrect default gateway
fix_steps: Set gateway to 192.168.10.1; renew address; test remote ping

symptom: Users in VLAN 20 cannot reach routed networks
topology_note: Endpoint and SVI/default-gateway configuration
show_outputs: show ip interface brief shows Vlan20 administratively down
expected_fault: VLAN 20 SVI is shutdown
fix_steps: Enable the SVI and verify line protocol

topology_note: Endpoint and SVI/default-gateway configuration
show_outputs: Host uses 255.255.255.0 but gateway is outside the local subnet
expected_fault: Host subnet configuration does not match gateway network
fix_steps: Correct IP/mask or gateway so both are in the same subnet

topology_note: Endpoint and SVI/default-gateway configuration
show_outputs: ARP table shows two MAC addresses for the same gateway IP
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address is configured on two devices
fix_steps: Identify duplicate device and correct its IP; clear ARP; retest

topology_note: Client VLAN and DHCP service/relay configuration
show_outputs: DHCP pool has no available addresses
expected_fault: DHCP pool is exhausted
fix_steps: Expand/clean the pool; verify excluded addresses; renew DHCP

symptom: Remote VLAN clients do not get addresses
topology_note: Client VLAN and DHCP service/relay configuration
show_outputs: Client VLAN is on switch but no ip helper-address is configured on SVI
expected_fault: DHCP relay is missing on the remote VLAN interface
fix_steps: Add the correct helper address; renew client DHCP

topology_note: Client VLAN and DHCP service/relay configuration
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool shows network 192.168.40.0 while clients are VLAN 30
expected_fault: DHCP pool network does not match client VLAN
fix_steps: Correct the DHCP network/default-router options; renew clients

symptom: Ping by IP works but hostname lookup fails
topology_note: Client DNS and lab DNS server configuration
show_outputs: nslookup points to 192.168.50.5 but DNS server is unreachable
expected_fault: DNS server address/reachability is incorrect
fix_steps: Correct DNS server address or restore reachability; retest resolution

topology_note: Client DNS and lab DNS server configuration
show_outputs: ipconfig shows DNS 192.168.1.1; lab DNS is 192.168.10.53
expected_fault: Client is configured with wrong DNS server
fix_steps: Set DNS server to 192.168.10.53; flush DNS; retest

topology_note: Client DNS and lab DNS server configuration
show_outputs: DNS server reachable but answer is NXDOMAIN for intranet.local
expected_fault: Required DNS record is missing
fix_steps: Create/correct the DNS record; verify TTL and lookup

topology_note: Router routing table and next-hop configuration
show_outputs: show ip route has no 10.20.0.0/16 route
expected_fault: Required route to remote LAN is missing
fix_steps: Add/restore the correct route; verify next hop; retest

topology_note: Router routing table and next-hop configuration
show_outputs: show ip route 10.20.0.0/16 points to an incorrect next hop
expected_fault: Static route uses an unreachable/wrong next hop
fix_steps: Correct the next-hop address; verify adjacency; retest

topology_note: Router routing table and next-hop configuration
show_outputs: Router has connected routes but no 0.0.0.0/0 entry
expected_fault: Default route is missing
fix_steps: Configure the correct default route; verify reachability

topology_note: Router routing table and next-hop configuration
show_outputs: show ip ospf interface lists other interfaces but not 10.30.0.0/24
expected_fault: The subnet is not included in OSPF advertisement
fix_steps: Add the subnet to OSPF; verify neighbor/routes

symptom: Clients can ping server but cannot resolve names
topology_note: Router/switch ACL policy and interface direction
show_outputs: show access-lists shows deny udp any host 192.168.10.53 eq 53
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies DNS traffic
fix_steps: Adjust ACL order/permit DNS traffic; verify with counters

topology_note: Router/switch ACL policy and interface direction
show_outputs: ACL is applied inbound on the interface though policy expects outbound filtering
expected_fault: ACL direction/application point is incorrect
fix_steps: Move/apply ACL in intended direction after human review

topology_note: Router/switch ACL policy and interface direction
show_outputs: ACL uses an incorrect wildcard for the intended subnet
expected_fault: ACL wildcard mask does not match the intended network
fix_steps: Correct wildcard; verify with test source addresses

topology_note: Router/switch ACL policy and interface direction
show_outputs: Permit statements exist but no permit for the new server subnet
expected_fault: Traffic reaches implicit deny
fix_steps: Add a narrowly scoped permit before implicit deny; verify

symptom: Inside clients cannot reach outside server
topology_note: Edge router NAT inside/outside configuration
show_outputs: show ip nat translations is empty during traffic generation
expected_fault: NAT rule/interface roles are incomplete
fix_steps: Verify inside/outside interfaces and NAT rule; generate traffic; retest

topology_note: Edge router NAT inside/outside configuration
show_outputs: Inside interface is marked ip nat outside
expected_fault: NAT roles are reversed
fix_steps: Correct inside/outside roles; clear translations; retest

symptom: Only some users have internet access
topology_note: Edge router NAT inside/outside configuration
show_outputs: NAT ACL permits 192.168.10.0/24 but users are in 192.168.20.0/24
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not include the user subnet
fix_steps: Update NAT ACL for the intended subnet; verify translations

symptom: Guest device can ping internal server
topology_note: Wireless SSID, VLAN and isolation configuration
show_outputs: Guest SSID maps to VLAN 40 but ACL has no isolation deny
expected_fault: Guest isolation policy is missing or incomplete
fix_steps: Apply reviewed guest-to-internal isolation policy; retest

topology_note: Wireless SSID, VLAN and isolation configuration
show_outputs: AP/SSID configuration maps Staff SSID to VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 10
expected_fault: SSID-to-VLAN mapping is incorrect
fix_steps: Correct SSID VLAN mapping; renew client; verify subnet

symptom: Wi-Fi clients associate but get no IP
topology_note: Wireless SSID, VLAN and isolation configuration
show_outputs: Wireless VLAN exists but DHCP relay is missing
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN lacks DHCP service/relay
fix_steps: Configure DHCP service/relay; renew wireless client

symptom: Guest clients can reach each other
topology_note: Wireless SSID, VLAN and isolation configuration
show_outputs: Wireless controller shows client isolation disabled for guest SSID
expected_fault: Client isolation is disabled on guest network
fix_steps: Enable reviewed client isolation setting; test guest-to-guest traffic

symptom: Wi-Fi has IP but cannot leave subnet
topology_note: Wireless SSID, VLAN and isolation configuration
show_outputs: Client gateway belongs to VLAN 10 while SSID is VLAN 60
expected_fault: Wireless client is using a gateway from the wrong VLAN
fix_steps: Correct DHCP/default gateway for VLAN 60; renew client
